issues.display_title: Issue #46: Task: recompute ranking on service/sublocation writes + clear v2 directory list cache on all scored write paths (follow-up #13)
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 22/07/26

✅ Implementation Report: Issue #46 Ranking Recompute + V2 Cache Invalidation

Issue: #46

PR: #48

Summary

Implemented the follow-up fix for stale v2 photographer directory ordering.

The issue had two related problems:

  • Service and sublocation writes changed fields that affect ranking, but did not recompute the stored photographers.ranking` value.
  • Several scored write paths could leave GET /v2/photographers/users serving stale cached ordering from PhotographerListV2.

Review Update

PR review found a race in the first implementation:

clear V2 cache -> async RecomputeAndSaveRanking -> DB ranking update

A request between the cache clear and the ranking update could rebuild the v2 list cache using the old ranking, then keep that stale cache for up to 24 hours.

The implementation was updated so RecomputeAndSaveRanking clears PhotographerListV2 only after the ranking update succeeds. This makes the cache invalidation happen at the true source of ranking changes and covers all current ranking recompute callers, including the ranking backfill flow.

Files Changed

  • src/action/v1/photographers/computeRanking.go
  • src/action/v1/services/addPhotographerServices.go
  • src/action/v1/services/removePhotographerServices.go
  • src/action/v1/sublocations/addSublocation.go
  • src/action/v1/sublocations/removeSublocation.go
  • src/action/v1/sublocations/updateSublocation.go

Implementation Details

Central V2 Cache Invalidation

RecomputeAndSaveRanking now clears the v2 photographer list cache after persisting the new ranking:

if err := config.GetConnPhotographers().Model(&p).Update("ranking", ranking).Error; err == nil { //nolint
	_, _ = helpers.ClearRedisKeys(helpers.RedisKey.PhotographerListV2Pattern())
}

This prevents the stale-cache race and avoids duplicating v2 list invalidation across every write path that recomputes ranking.

Service Writes

Added ranking recompute after successful service assignment changes:

  • AddPhotographerService
  • RemovePhotographerService

These paths now call:

go photographers.RecomputeAndSaveRanking(gothruUserID)

Reason: ServiceCount > 0 contributes to ranking.

Sublocation Writes

Added ranking recompute after successful sublocation changes:

  • AddSublocation
  • RemoveSublocation
  • UpdateSublocation

These paths now call:

go photographers.RecomputeAndSaveRanking(photographer.GothruUserID)

Reason: SublocationCount > 0 contributes to ranking.

Behavior

  • Adding or removing a photographer service updates the stored ranking asynchronously.
  • Adding, removing, or updating a sublocation updates the stored ranking asynchronously.
  • After ranking is saved, PhotographerListV2 cache is cleared.
  • The next GET /v2/photographers/users request rebuilds list ordering from the updated ranking.
  • Ranking backfill also clears v2 list cache through the shared recompute path.

Verification

Ran:

go build ./...
go test ./...

Result: pass.

Notes

  • V1 photographer list cache remains out of scope, per issue clarification.
  • Status/apply/revert/delete paths keep their own direct v2 cache clears because they do not rely solely on RecomputeAndSaveRanking.
  • PR #48 has been merged into main.

Follow-up task for the remaining QA blockers in #13. Code-validated on main (2026-07-22). Scope is the v2 directory list flow only — v1 list cache (PhotographerListPattern()) is out of scope per product clarification in #13.

Validated findings

1. Missing RecomputeAndSaveRanking on scored write paths

ComputeRanking gives +1 for ServiceCount > 0 and SublocationCount > 0 (src/action/v1/photographers/computeRanking.go:73,82), but these write paths never recompute:

File Gap
src/action/v1/services/addPhotographerServices.go No RecomputeAndSaveRanking call
src/action/v1/services/removePhotographerServices.go No RecomputeAndSaveRanking call
src/action/v1/sublocations/addSublocation.go No RecomputeAndSaveRanking call (not listed in #13, but SublocationCount is scored)
src/action/v1/sublocations/removeSublocation.go No RecomputeAndSaveRanking call
src/action/v1/sublocations/updateSublocation.go No RecomputeAndSaveRanking call

Impact: adding/removing the first or last service/sublocation leaves the persisted ranking stale, so v2 directory ordering is wrong.

2. Missing PhotographerListV2Pattern() invalidation on scored write paths

Only updatePhotographerLocation, applyPhotographer, revertApprovedToPending, deletePhotographerProfile, and updatePhotographerStatus clear the v2 list cache today. These scored paths do not:

File Current state
src/action/v1/services/addPhotographerServices.go Clears detail/services/geodata/count only
src/action/v1/services/removePhotographerServices.go Clears detail/services/geodata/count only
src/action/v1/availabilities/addPhotographerAvailability.go Clears detail/geodata/count only
src/action/v1/availabilities/removePhotographerAvailability.go Clears detail/geodata/count only
src/action/v1/photographers/addPhotographerEquipment.go Clears detail/equipment/geodata/count only
src/action/v1/photographers/removePhotographerEquipment.go Clears detail/equipment/geodata/count only
src/action/v1/portfolio/portfolioHelper.go (invalidateRedisCache, used by create/update/delete portfolio) Clears portfolio/detail only
src/action/v1/photographers/updatePhotographerProfile.go:289 Clears v1 PhotographerListPattern() but not v2
src/action/v1/sublocations/addSublocation.go / removeSublocation.go / updateSublocation.go Clears detail/location/geodata/count/markers only

Impact: v2 photographer list (GET /v2/photographers/users, cached via PhotographerListV2 in src/action/v2/photographers/getPhotographers.go:157) keeps serving stale ranking/order after data changes.

Tasks

  • Add go photographers.RecomputeAndSaveRanking(photographer.GothruUserID) after successful write in addPhotographerServices.go and removePhotographerServices.go
  • Same for sublocations/addSublocation.go, removeSublocation.go, updateSublocation.go
  • Add helpers.ClearRedisKeys(helpers.RedisKey.PhotographerListV2Pattern()) to every scored write path listed in table 2 (services, availabilities, equipment, portfolio helper, profile update, sublocations)
  • go build ./... and go test ./... pass

Acceptance criteria

  • Adding/removing a service or sublocation updates the stored ranking column.
  • After any scored write (profile, location, equipment, portfolio, availability, service, sublocation), the next GET /v2/photographers/users reflects the new ranking/order (no stale cache).

Refs: #13 (QA report with full code-review table)

issues.display_title: Issue #47: feat: API endpoint for global average rating (directory stats)
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 22/07/26

✅ Implementation Report: Issue #47 Global Average Rating API

Issue: #47

Branch: feat/issue-47-rating-summary

Summary

Implemented a backend endpoint for the directory-wide average photographer rating.

The frontend currently uses a hardcoded average rating stat. This task adds a real API source for that value, backed by the reviews table and cached in Redis.

Endpoint

GET /v1/photographers/rating-summary

Example API Hit

curl -X GET "http://localhost:3000/v1/photographers/rating-summary" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"

With cache bypass:

curl -X GET "http://localhost:3000/v1/photographers/rating-summary?disablecache=true" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"

Example Response

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "requestTime": 12,
  "data": {
    "avgRating": 4.8,
    "totalReviews": 123
  }
}

When no visible rated reviews exist:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "requestTime": 8,
  "data": {
    "avgRating": 0,
    "totalReviews": 0
  }
}

Source Of Truth

The endpoint calculates:

SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS total_reviews
FROM reviews
WHERE rating IS NOT NULL AND status IN (2, 3);

Reason:

  • reviews.rating is the per-review source of truth.
  • Existing public review listing uses status IN (2, 3) in src/action/v1/reviews/getReviews.go, so the rating summary follows the same visible-review definition.
  • Averaging reviews weights each review equally. It avoids averaging photographers.rating_avg, which would weight each photographer equally regardless of review count.

Files Changed

  • src/action/v1/photographers/getRatingSummary.go
  • src/action/v1/photographers/getRatingSummary_test.go
  • src/controllers/v1/photographers/getRatingSummary.go
  • src/routes/v1/photographersRoutes.go
  • src/helpers/redis_keys.go
  • src/action/v1/reviews/addReview.go
  • src/action/v1/reviews/addLinkedinReview.go

Implementation Details

Action

Added:

func GetRatingSummary() (*RatingSummary, error)

Response DTO:

type RatingSummary struct {
	AvgRating    float64 `json:"avgRating"`
	TotalReviews int64   `json:"totalReviews"`
}

The query uses sql.NullFloat64 so an empty review set returns avgRating: 0 instead of null.

Controller

Added:

func GetRatingSummary(c *fiber.Ctx) error

Behavior:

  • Supports X-Cache-Version.
  • Supports cache bypass through disablecache=true, x-disable-cache: true, or disablecache: true.
  • Returns 200 even when there are no reviews, with zero values.

Route

Added:

group.Get("/rating-summary", photographersController.GetRatingSummary)

Final route:

GET /v1/photographers/rating-summary

Redis Cache

Added cache key:

helpers.RedisKey.PhotographerRatingSummary(version)

Key format:

photographer:v{version}:rating-summary

Added invalidation pattern:

helpers.RedisKey.PhotographerRatingSummaryPattern()

Pattern:

photographer:v*:rating-summary

Cache Invalidation

Added invalidation after successful review submission in:

  • src/action/v1/reviews/addReview.go
  • src/action/v1/reviews/addLinkedinReview.go

Both paths now clear:

helpers.RedisKey.PhotographerRatingSummaryPattern()

Tests Added

Added action tests:

  • TestGetRatingSummaryUsesVisibleRatedReviews
  • TestGetRatingSummaryReturnsZeroWhenNoRatedReviews

The tests verify:

  • Query filters to visible rated reviews with status IN (2, 3).
  • Average rating is returned with one decimal.
  • Empty review set returns avgRating = 0 and totalReviews = 0.

Verification

Ran:

go test ./src/action/v1/photographers -run TestGetRatingSummary -count=1
go build ./...
go test ./...

Result: pass.

Notes

  • This implementation uses a new endpoint instead of extending GET /v1/photographers/count, so frontend can fetch rating stats separately from count stats.
  • No review status-change endpoint was found in this repo. Cache invalidation was added to the two review creation/submission paths currently present.

The frontend (gothru-photographer-v2) shows a hardcoded "4.8/5 · Avg rating" stat tile on the home, about, and directory pages. There is no backend endpoint that returns the directory-wide average rating.

Current state (validated 2026-07-22)

  • Per-review rating exists: reviews.rating (src/models/directory_review.go, Rating *int8, plus Status int8).
  • Per-photographer aggregate exists: photographers.rating_avg (src/models/directory_photographer.go, RatingAvg *float32).
  • No route exposes a global average. Existing stats endpoint: GET /v1/photographers/count (src/routes/v1/photographersRoutes.go:26).

Task

Add an endpoint that returns the directory-wide average rating, e.g.:

GET /v1/photographers/rating-summary

Response:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "avgRating": 4.8,
    "totalReviews": 123
  }
}

Implementation notes:

  • Source of truth: AVG(rating) over reviews where rating IS NOT NULL and status = published/approved (confirm which status value counts as visible — reviews default to status = 1). Alternative is averaging photographers.rating_avg > 0, but that weights each photographer equally instead of each review; pick one and document it.
  • Round to 1 decimal.
  • Cache in Redis (same pattern as PhotographerCountPattern() in src/helpers/redis_keys.go) and invalidate it in the review write paths (src/action/v1/reviews/addReview.go, addLinkedinReview.go, and any review status-change path).
  • Extending GET /v1/photographers/count with an avgRating field is an acceptable alternative to a new route since the FE already calls it — dev's choice.

Acceptance

  • Endpoint returns real average rating + review count, cached.
  • Adding a review invalidates the cache; next call reflects the new average.

FE counterpart: GoThruMedia/gothru-photographer-v2#14
